2026-12-18.title: Third Friday of Annunciation · The Miraculous Cross at Mylapore
2026-12-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: God raised Jesus whom you crucified
Jesus the Way, the Truth and the Life
2026-12-18.alt: Weekday readings: Colossians 1:10–16 (Lead a life pleasing to the Lord); Mark 1:1–8 (One more powerful than I is coming).
2026-12-18.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”
theo: Today the Syro-Malabar calendar commemorates the Miraculous Cross at Mylapore. The ancient stone cross with a Pahlavi inscription, found on St Thomas Mount near Chennai in the sixteenth century and venerated in connection with the apostle Thomas, is one of the oldest Christian monuments in India. Tradition records that it showed miraculous signs during the Holy Qurbana. Whatever one makes of the reports, the cross itself witnesses to the antiquity of the faith of the St Thomas Christians, who honoured the Cross without a corpus as the sign of victory and life.

The readings unfold the meaning of the Cross. Moses strikes the rock and water flows; the Fathers saw this fulfilled when the soldier's lance opened Christ's side. Peter proclaims: “God has made him both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified.” Paul says Christ reconciled Jews and Gentiles “to God in one body through the cross.” And Jesus, about to go to his Passion, tells Thomas: “I am the way.” The Way passes through the Cross.
outline: Ask: what does the cross in your home mean to you?
The struck Rock is Christ; from his side flows life.
The Cross breaks down walls and reconciles.
Thomas asked the way; the Way is the crucified and risen Lord.
“We adore you, O Christ, and we bless you, for by your holy Cross you have redeemed the world.”
live: Pray before the cross in your home tonight as a family.
Reconcile with one person before Christmas.
saints: The Miraculous Cross at Mylapore (18 December)
The ancient Persian stone cross of St Thomas Mount, venerated by the St Thomas Christians; the Syro-Malabar Church keeps its memory today.
2026-12-18.prayer: Lord Jesus, you made peace through your Cross and opened the way to the Father. As our fathers in faith honoured your Cross, let us glory in it and walk your way to life. Amen.
altar: The Holy Qurbana makes present the sacrifice of the Cross. From the altar, as from the struck rock, flows the living water of grace.

quick: The ancient Mylapore cross witnesses to the antiquity of our faith.
From the struck Rock, Christ, flows life.
The Cross is the way to peace and to the Father.
2026-12-18.action: Pray before the cross at home tonight.
2026-12-18.question: Do I see the Cross as a sign of victory and life?

family.explain: Jesus told Thomas: I am the Way. Our Mar Thoma cross reminds us that Jesus' Cross leads to new life, like a tree that blossoms.
family.intention: We pray for all St Thomas Christians in India and around the world.
family.ask: Ask: “Where is the Mar Thoma cross in our home, and what does it teach us?”

pm.open: Lord Jesus, by your Cross you reconciled us to God and to one another. As we gather before the sign of your victory, quench our thirst with the living water of your Spirit. Amen.
share: The rock struck in the desert gave water (Exodus 17:6). What suffering in my life could become a source of grace?
Jesus says: do not let your hearts be troubled (John 14:1). What troubles my heart today?
How does the Cross unite what is divided in my family or community?
pm.resp: We adore you, O Christ, for by your Cross you have redeemed the world.
interc: For the St Thomas Christians in India and the diaspora, that they may treasure their ancient faith.
For unity among Christians, that the Cross may break down every dividing wall.
For those who suffer, that they may find in the Cross a source of living water.
For those whose hearts are troubled, that they may find Jesus the Way.
For our parish, that we may honour the Cross by lives of love and sacrifice.
pm.close: Lord God, from the Cross of your Son flows living water. Through the prayers of St Thomas the apostle, keep us faithful to the faith of our fathers and lead us by the Way of the Cross to your house. Amen.

illus: A widow in Kuravilangad hung a Mar Thoma cross in her kitchen after her husband's death. “When I look at it,” she said, “I remember that the Cross ends in flowers. My sorrow will end in flowers too.”

homily: Dear friends, today the Syro-Malabar Church remembers the Miraculous Cross of Mylapore, the ancient stone cross found on St Thomas Mount near Chennai, one of the oldest Christian monuments in India (H). It reminds us that the faith of the St Thomas Christians is ancient, and that our fathers honoured the Cross as the sign of life and victory.

In the first reading the people in the desert are thirsty and angry. God tells Moses to strike the rock, and water flows out (Exodus 17:6). The Fathers of the Church saw in this a sign of Christ, the Rock struck on the Cross, from whose side flowed blood and water.

St Peter, on Pentecost, proclaims: God has made him both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified (Acts 2:36). The Cross was not defeat; it was the throne from which Christ was raised to glory.
St Paul says Christ is our peace: he has broken down the dividing wall, reconciling both groups to God in one body through the cross (Ephesians 2:14–16). The Cross unites what sin divided.

In the Gospel, Jesus says to Thomas and the apostles: do not let your hearts be troubled; I am the way, and the truth, and the life (John 14:1, 6). Our apostle Thomas asked the question, and Jesus answered with himself. The Way passes through the Cross to the Father's house.

The St Thomas cross has no corpus: it is the Cross of the Risen One, blossoming at its ends, with the dove of the Spirit above. When we look at it, let us remember that every suffering united to Christ can become a source of living water. Let us bring our troubles to the Cross today and hear: do not let your hearts be troubled. Amen.
kids: Children, the cross shows us how much Jesus loves us. Make the sign of the cross slowly and with love today!

sub: Moses strikes the rock at Horeb.
From Christ's pierced side flow blood and water.
q: I will be standing there in front of you on the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it, so that the people may drink.
Let the entire house of Israel know with certainty that God has made him both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified.
points.apply: Pray before the cross at home tonight.

sub: The bronze serpent lifted up brought healing.
The Cross lifted up brings salvation.
q: So Moses made a serpent of bronze, and put it upon a pole; and whenever a serpent bit someone, that person would look at the serpent of bronze and live.
And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.
points.apply: Look at a crucifix in silence for five minutes.
